drivers.label: Drivers · causes
drivers.title: What makes this block hot

why.sealed: Concrete and asphalt soak up sun all day and give the heat back at night, so the block never fully cools.
why.green: Trees cool by shade and by evaporating water. Less green cover means less of both.
why.roofs: Dark roofs get far hotter than light ones at noon and heat the rooms under them.
why.density: Tightly packed buildings trap heat and block the wind, so nights stay warm.

fix.sealed: Swap some paving for grass pavers or tree pits
fix.green: Plant street trees along the main roads
fix.roofs: Cool-roof coating on the largest roofs
fix.density: Shade sails over the narrowest lanes

drivers.source: Heat estimate: OpenStreetMap land cover + live weather. Dark roofs are an assumed share for the country.
